response.text:
I can’t run background monitoring or send you a message later — I can’t watch the vendor portal while you’re flying. I can, however, set up instructions or draft automations so you get notified automatically.

Options (pick one) — I’ll prepare exact steps or a drafted message once you confirm:
- Quick website-change alert (Visualping, Distill.io) — watches the portal page and sends email/SMS/push.
- Portal email/notification setup — I can draft the text and steps to enable the vendor portal’s built-in alert (if it has one).
- Automation (Zapier/IFTTT) — watch a feed/email and send SMS/Slack/push when the SOC2 lands.
- Ask the vendor to notify you — I can draft a short message to send them requesting immediate notification when the report is posted.

Which option do you want me to prepare, and do you want a ready-to-send vendor message? If you pick an option, tell me if you prefer SMS, email, or Slack notifications and whether you can install a browser extension or use Zapier/IFTTT.
